summary: Frontend-only test of the 4-level badge system (Recruit/Analyst/Hunter/Elite). Working: the landing showcase (4 level cards and 8 badges, all images load, round art, CTA goes to /register, no horizontal scroll at 390px), the dashboard BadgeTiles (correct levels, locked badges are greyscale with a lock icon, the course badge shows Recruit with course.jpg), the /u/demo profile tiles, the /app/courses course badge art and the 'Join SOCProfessionals Academy' CTA. All 12 /badges/* files return 200. One open bug: on desktop, 6 of the 8 badge names on the landing showcase are cut off with an ellipsis.

ui_bugs.component: BadgeShowcase LevelCard (landing, desktop 1920px and lg 4-column grid)
ui_bugs.issue: Badge names are cut off by the `truncate` class: 'First Bl…', 'Triage P…', 'Quiz Mas…', 'Week Wat…', 'Pathfind…', 'Night Sh…'. The review asked for names that are not cut off. The cause is a 2-column grid inside a narrow 4-column card with a 44px image. Fine at 390px.

issues: The Recruit level art (level-recruit.jpg) has a plain white background, which clashes with the dark theme next to the other 3 dark cards. The 'LEVEL 01' label (text-slate-500) is hard to read where the gradient meets the white image.
Analyst level art reuses /badges/triage-pro.jpg, so the Analyst card image is the same as the Triage Pro badge icon. There is no separate Analyst level art.
'Log in' wraps onto two lines and the 'Sign up' button text wraps as well. The header is crowded on mobile.

action_items: BadgeShowcase.jsx: stop badge names being cut off on desktop. Options: remove `truncate` and allow 2 lines (e.g. line-clamp-2 / break-words), or stack the 2 badges in 1 column inside each level card at lg, or use smaller text.
Optional: give level-recruit.jpg a dark background (or darken it with a CSS overlay) so it matches the other level cards.
Optional: make the mobile header buttons compact (whitespace-nowrap, smaller padding).
critical_code_review_comments: The served index.html meta description reads 'A product of emergent.sh' on both the public URL and localhost:3000, even though public/index.html has the new SOCProfessionals description. Most likely cause: the @emergentbase/overlay dev-server plugin in craco rewrites it. A production build should be fine; check the deployed build.
badgeArt() returns both img and img2. Because of the spread, img is overwritten by the level image and img2 is the badge image. This is confusing naming; rename to levelImg/badgeImg.
MyCourses hardcodes /badges/course.jpg instead of using badgeArt(), so the image path is duplicated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Badge art lives in frontend/src/lib/badges.js (LEVELS, BADGE_ART, SHOWCASE_BADGES). The demo student has first-blood and course-585979 (Wireshark) earned; the rest are locked. Check that landing badge names are no longer cut off at 1920px.
